The text contains both objective and subjective elements. The statement "Many scientists agree that climate change is exacerbated by human activity" is an objective fact, as it reports a verifiable consensus or survey result within the scientific community. However, the phrase "there are still some dissenting voices" introduces a subjective nuance by framing the existence of disagreement, which can be interpreted as an opinion on the state of scientific consensus, though it is also factually true that dissent exists. Overall, the text is primarily objective because it reports on the state of opinion rather than stating a personal belief itself.
